title: Visit summary + commitment extraction
description: Output of /api/summarise. Organises a consultation transcript into a patient-facing summary and extracts the trackable commitments that open the interval.

patient_symptoms_summary.description: What the patient described, in plain language. "" if not discussed.

doctor_diagnosis.description: The diagnosis as the doctor stated it, plus a short plain-language explanation grounded only in facts already present elsewhere in the transcript. "" if none given.

doctor_advice.description: Advice as stated by the doctor. Never the model's own advice.

red_flags.description: Reasons the doctor said to come back or seek urgent care.

dosage.description: Exactly as stated. "" if unclear or inaudible — omitted rather than guessed or flagged.

commitments.description: Concrete, trackable things agreed to happen before the next visit. Prose advice with no action is not a commitment.

text.description: What was agreed, addressed to the patient in the second person.

timeframe.description: As stated, e.g. "6 weeks", "before next visit". "" if unstated.

source_quote.description: The transcript line this was drawn from. The audit trail proving the loop is made of real data.
